proposed_donor.language: Persian-origin regional loan; immediate donor unresolved

proposals.evidence: Probable Persian-origin regional loan family. CDIAL137 identifies Romani angustrī/angrušti ring as probably from Persian aṅguštarī; CDIAL138 specifically distinguishes Kati aṅüští from r-bearing aṅuštrí, calling the latter probably Persian-derived. Dameli aŋgūśterī and independently attested Palula aŋguśtē̂ri share the r-bearing shape, favouring this loan family over an unqualified reflex of Sanskrit aṅguṣṭhiya. Waigali aṅguštī and Kati forms remain comparanda, not established donors to Dameli. A Nuristani intermediary is possible but unproven; direct Persian versus regional transmission remains unresolved. No direct Sanskrit or remote Persian edge is saved.
proposals.save_blocker: Immediate language and donor node unresolved; Nuristani comparison does not establish transmission.
proposals.donor_selection_note: Selected under the user’s donor preference; existing source evidence and uncertainties remain authoritative. This preference alone does not establish historical direction or supply a missing/linkable donor ID.

approval: User: approve all; prefer Pashto where best matched, then Urdu for broadly Perso-Arabic terms. Approval includes qualified analyses, not a claim that uncertainties are resolved.
donor_policy: Prefer an attested Pashto donor where form and meaning fit best; otherwise prefer Urdu for broadly shared Perso-Arabic loans. Preserve explicit source attribution, phonological uncertainty and possible Nuristani mediation. Do not substitute a different dialect merely because its node is linkable.
